common.openShiftAddedLater: The shift you're on is added when you clock out.

layout.notAMember: You aren't a member of any organization, so there is nothing to clock in to. Ask your manager to add you.

login.description: Sign in to log your shifts
login.passwordSet: Your password is set. Sign in with it.

setPassword.title: Set your password
setPassword.description: Choose the password you'll use to sign in to the timeclock.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.description: Enter the e-mail you sign in with and we'll send you a link to set a new password.

clock.offline: You're offline. Clocking in and out needs a connection.

error.alreadyClockedIn: You're already clocked in, maybe from another tab or phone. Here is your current shift.
error.notClockedIn: You're not clocked in, maybe you clocked out from another tab or phone.
error.tooSoon: You clocked in a moment ago. Wait a few seconds and try again.
error.noAccess: You no longer have access to this organization. Ask your manager.

request.newTimesDescription: Your shift {{range}}. A manager changes it when they approve.
request.missingDescription: A shift you worked but did not clock. A manager adds it when they approve.
request.stillAtWork: Leave empty if you are still at work.
request.nextDay: The next day: the clock-out is not after the clock-in.
request.whyNewTimesPlaceholder: e.g. I forgot to clock out

requests.title: My requests
requests.none: No requests yet. Ask for a change from <shifts>My shifts</shifts>.

pay.title: My pay
pay.estimateExplanation: Gross, from your finished shifts so far at your rate. The approved amount can differ: hours may be rounded, and bonuses or advances are added then.
pay.noRate: No pay rate is set for you yet, so this shows no pay. Ask your manager to set your rate.
pay.someWithoutRate_one: No pay rate is set for {{count}} shift, so it isn't counted. Ask your manager to set your rate.
pay.someWithoutRate_other: No pay rate is set for {{count}} shifts, so they aren't counted. Ask your manager to set your rate.

closeDay.title: Close the day
closeDay.cannotClose: The day can't be closed yet: no cash storage or denomination is set up. Ask your manager.
closeDay.alreadyClosed: {{date}} is already closed, by {{name}} at {{time}}. If something is wrong, ask your manager to correct it.

storage.depositHint: Enter only what you're putting into {{name}} now.
storage.countedHint: Count what stays in {{name}} and enter every denomination. Leave a field empty for none.

payments.title: Other payments
payments.hint: Enter the day's amount of each, as the terminal or report shows it. Leave a field empty for none.

summary.title: Check and close
summary.cashIncomeLater: The day's cash income is worked out when you close the day.

receipt.title: {{date}} is closed
receipt.unknownMethod: A payment method no longer offered
receipt.shortage: The cash is short by {{amount}}. The day's cash income is booked as 0, and your manager will check it.
